item.title: From Cron Job to Self-Healing Pipeline, what I learnt in my first year building EO data pipelines
item.description: When I was working as a marine scientist I used to babysit my data pipelines, checking the outputs every morning and re-running things by hand. Here is what I learnt in my first year building reliable Earth observation pipelines.

item.title: EOPF Explorer: Sentinel Pipelines for ESA
